The image has a strong cyan/teal color cast and significant blur/soft focus. There are prominent 'iStockphoto' watermarks overlaid across the center.

Heavy-handed color grading (cyan/teal cast) and soft-focus blur obscure fine details. Skin texture looks plasticky and unnatural, potentially indicative of AI smoothing or aggressive post-processing.

The fingers holding the bandage are indistinct and blend into the background/skin. The anatomy of the hand is vague, lacking clear definition of knuckles or nails, suggestive of minor generative ambiguity or motion blur simulation failure.
